fps.description: Camera ingest FPS. Used to derive per-detection timestamp (startTime + frame_id/fps) for speed regression and evidence timing.

max_miss.description: Maximum number of consecutive missed detections allowed before a track is considered lost. Must be a non-negative integer.

cam_resolution.description: Camera resolution must have exactly two non-negative integers representing [width, height].

items.description: Each point must have exactly two non-negative integers representing [x, y] coordinates.

min_distance_MHE_same_lane.description: Minimum distance in meters to consider a same-lane collision between two MHEs. Must be a non-negative number.

min_speed_kmh.description: Minimum speed in km/h; at least one of the two MHEs must exceed this to count as a violation.

min_moving_kmh.description: Minimum speed in km/h for an MHE to be considered moving (below this it is treated as stationary and excluded).
